channel.title: Aayushman Manda
channel.description: Research notes and updates from Aayushman Manda.

item.title: Grading With Evidence: A Multi-Agent Auto-Assessment System
item.description: An evidence-anchored, multi-agent grading pipeline for handwritten and typed answer sheets, with deterministic score auditing and memory that carries across submissions.

item.title: Diffusion Autoencoders: Reproducing a Meaningful, Decodable Latent Space
item.description: Notes from reproducing Diffusion Autoencoders (CVPR 2022): a semantic encoder that gives diffusion models a compact, decodable, and editable latent code.

item.title: Poking Inside a Language Model with NNsight
item.description: How NNsight's tracing-context API makes activation patching, logit-lens probes, and targeted ablations practical without a bespoke hook harness.

item.title: Privacy Saturation in Noisy-SGD
item.description: A mathematical exploration of privacy saturation in noisy stochastic gradient descent.
